title: Sands Of Time
description:
Name: [The Ancient Remnant](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/remnant.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Cursed Pyramid located in deserts.
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Must be awakened by a [Necklace of The Desert](image:cataclysm:textures/item/necklace_of_the_desert.png) found buried within the sand of the pyramid. Extremely aggressive, attacks with charges, its tail, and twisters that disorientate its targets. Can begin to recover from damage when driven into a corner and is immune to projectiles, fire, and lava.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
